title: Very small font on the message count and weather badges
line: The temperature shown over the Weather widget's icon grows with the icon again instead of staying tiny on wide or tall panels.
explanation: In 6.6 BadgeOverlay sized its text to a quarter of the icon height when given an icon. Since its port to Kirigami.Badge (plasma-workspace 41b938d00d) it always uses the small font minus one point, so the Weather widget's temperature badge stays tiny on big icons, e.g. in the reporter's 94 px vertical panel. The weather applet now sets the badge font to a quarter of the icon height again (in points), never smaller than the old default, so small panels and the system tray look the same as before.

commits.message:
applets/weather: scale the temperature badge with the icon

BadgeOverlay got a fixed small font when it moved to Kirigami.Badge, so
the temperature shown over the icon became tiny on wide or tall panels.
Size its font to a quarter of the icon height again, as before 6.7.

CCBUG: 521854

patches.diff:
From f64d174114caad9f7665b2a2be37c07055385a98 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 01:47:44 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/weather: scale the temperature badge with the icon

BadgeOverlay got a fixed small font when it moved to Kirigami.Badge, so
the temperature shown over the icon became tiny on wide or tall panels.
Size its font to a quarter of the icon height again, as before 6.7.

CCBUG: 521854
---
 applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
index c66ae91a7..beb320722 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -74,6 +74,9 @@ Loader {
 
                 text: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(compactRoot.displayTemperatureUnit, compactRoot.lastObservation.temperature, compactRoot.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false) : "";
                 icon: parent
+                // Scale the text with the icon (a quarter of its height, in points)
+                // so the temperature stays readable on big icons
+                font.pointSize: Math.max(Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pointSize - 1, Math.round(weatherIcon.height * 0.75 / 4))
 
                 // Non-default state to center if the badge is wider than the icon
                 states: [
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, 94 px vertical panel, temperature over the widget icon: tiny 12°C badge on the big icon
With the fix: the badge text scales with the icon, as in 6.6

review.text: The patch only addresses the Weather widget temperature badge using CCBUG: 521854 and leaves the Task Manager message count badge unfixed (despite the bug report covering both and being filed under Task Manager, with verification confirming the Task Manager badge also shrank ~15-20% on a 94 px vertical panel), so no commit actually resolves the bug. Architecturally, the regression happened when the shared WorkspaceComponents.BadgeOverlay in plasma-workspace was ported to Kirigami.Badge and stopped scaling relative to its icon property, so scaling should be fixed in BadgeOverlay (and reconciled with Task Manager's badge) rather than worked around only in kdeplasma-addons. Finally, converting logical pixels to font.pointSize via a hardcoded 0.75 factor assumes 96 DPI and will mis-scale on systems with non-default font DPI.
changes: Address the full bug report (both the Weather badge and the Task Manager unread count badge sizing regression) so that the fix completely resolves the report and includes a BUG: 521854 commit rather than only a partial CCBUG.
Restore icon-relative badge scaling in the shared WorkspaceComponents.BadgeOverlay (plasma-workspace) instead of adding a one-off workaround in kdeplasma-addons's CompactRepresentation.qml.

Do not hardcode a 0.75 px-to-pt conversion factor (`weatherIcon.height * 0.75 / 4`) for font.pointSize, as it breaks when font DPI is not 96; compute font size in a DPI-independent way (e.g. pixelSize or scaling from Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pointSize relative to a reference icon size).

reviews.text: The weather change works (before/after-1 clearly show the temperature badge scaling with the 86 px icon again) and leaves small panels unchanged. But the bug, per its title and the reporter's 6.6 vs 6.7 comparison, also covers the task manager unread-count badge, which the tester measured still ~15-20% smaller than 6.6 on the 94 px panel; the commit only says CCBUG, so it does not close the bug. The scaling is also patched into one consumer instead of plasma-workspace's BadgeOverlay, whose icon property (now marked unused) exists exactly for this and is also used by the keyboard layout applet; and the hard-coded 0.75 px-to-pt factor breaks with a forced font DPI, where font.pixelSize would not.
changes: Restore icon-relative sizing in plasma-workspace components/workspace/BadgeOverlay.qml (when icon is set, size from icon.height, floor at the current small font) so weather and keyboard layout both get it, instead of a per-applet override
Use font.pixelSize (or derive from a pixel height) rather than converting px to pt with a fixed 0.75 factor
Address the task manager badge (TaskBadgeOverlay) so it matches 6.6 at large icon sizes, or get the bug retitled/split to weather-only, then use BUG: 521854
